title: Puzzle 3d Marquee Freeze And Accuracy
description: Add live highlight preview while dragging rectangle/lasso marquee and eliminate post-release freeze by caching projected footprints once per gesture and deferring host shell rebuild.
summary:
Fixed puzzle3d group-selection first-gesture freeze and inaccurate marquee hits.

Freeze: buildMarqueeCandidates no longer cold-traverses geometry on activation. Per-object footprint cache stores mesh local AABB corners (buildObjectMarqueeFootprintCache); warm on register (idle + rAF), on three-env attach, and rebuild when mesh count changes. Pointerdown prefetches candidates via rAF; activation reuses prefetched candidates while refreshing base selection.

Accuracy: MarqueeCandidate carries convex hull + screenBounds. Hit tests use hull (window: all hull points inside; crossing: screenRectIntersectsPolygon / screenPolygonsIntersect for lasso). Inflated screenBounds-only overlap no longer selects wrong objects.

218 @semio-tech/puzzle-3d-react tests pass.
